title: Edge element DtN method for electromagnetic scattering poles of perfectly conducting obstacles
summary: Meromorphic continuation of the scattering operator leads to scattering poles (resonances) in the complex plane. Despite their significance, numerical investigation of scattering poles remains limited. In this paper, we propose and analyze a numerical method to compute electromagnetic poles of perfectly conducting obstacles. The unbounded domain for the scattering problem is truncated using the DtN mapping and the poles are shown to be the eigenvalues of a holomorphic Fredholm operator function related to Maxwell's equations.
